title: Why Google, OpenAI and Anthropic keep changing AI prices
subtitle: Google, OpenAI and Anthropic keep changing their AI prices. How do you budget when the offer you sign up for can end?

Google public pricing doubles on 1 December 2026: input tokens rise from $2 to $4 per million and output tokens from $10 to $20.
Selected AI offers compared in US dollars per million tokens: $4 input and $20 output; Google from December and OpenAI promotional.
The article’s illustrative workload costs $980 before December and $1,960 afterwards, with the reuse discount included in both.
